question: What determines the state one attains at the moment of leaving the body?
premises: A person remembers some state at the end while abandoning the body.
One goes to that very state remembered at the end.
This occurs because one has always been imbued with that state.
inference: The final remembrance reflects long-standing inner conditioning and determines the state attained.
plain_english: Whatever state one remembers while leaving the body at the end, to that very state one goes, O son of Kuntī, because one has always been imbued with that state.
